title: T1000-E: GNSS (AG3335)
description: Validate AG3335 GNSS on T1000-E. GNSS is modeled and enabled by overlays but behavior needs validation. Test NMEA parsing, fix acquisition, and location submit.
notes: BLOCKED: Requires physical T1000-E hardware for validation. Software support is complete - DTS binding (airoha,ag3335.yaml), board config (t1000_e_nrf52840.dts with GNSS on UART1), and NMEA feeder tool (gnss_nmea_feeder.py) are all in place. Hardware validation tasks: (1) verify NMEA sentence parsing from real AG3335 chip, (2) test GPS fix acquisition (requires outdoor clear-sky environment), (3) validate location submission flow.
